verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's official BYOK documentation states that you can bring your own provider keys alongside or instead of OpenRouter credits, giving direct control over rate limits and costs through your provider account. The providers page also lists BYOK. This delivers the core of the story, but the evidence is a short docs excerpt with no detail on how keys are configured or how traffic is routed through them. Missing for 10: setup and configuration detail (per-provider key entry, fallback behavior when a BYOK key fails, any BYOK fees), plus independent or hands-on corroboration that traffic actually uses the supplied keys.
